outdated.message: The firmware of the board is outdated. Update it? The program currently on the board will be erased.

examples.crossroads: Alternate two traffic axes without ever causing a crash.
examples.carton-sorting: Route each carton to the right conveyor according to its height.
examples.drilling: Sequence the lowering, drilling and raising of an automatic drill.
